source_identity.canonical_title: Le concept de "cancel culture" sert d'écran de fumée à des méfaits bien réels

translation.canonical_title: The concept of "cancel culture" serves as a smokescreen for very real wrongdoing
translation.displayed_title: The concept of "cancel culture" serves as a smokescreen for very real wrongdoing
translation.summary: People are outraged by demands that Polanski pay for raping a minor; they are outraged that transgender people are unhappy that J. K. Rowling gratuitously spewed her bile in their faces; they are outraged that Bastien Vivès, an author of child pornography (and probably himself a child sex offender), should not be honored with an exhibition; and they are also outraged that the rapes committed by Depardieu should not go unpunished. Through these examples, it becomes obvious that playing the “cancel culture” card is merely a crude but effective way to portray our idols as innocent victims.

source_parameters.name: citation
source_parameters.value: Alors arrêtons de faire comme si nous étions atteints de cécité sélective. Personne ne demande de « Cancel » Depardieu. '''C’est une tentative de victimisation d’un agresseur sexuel qui assume à de nombreuses reprises et publiquement ses comportements.''' Depardieu fête ses 75 ans. Il sait à peine marcher. Il a fait une longue carrière dans le cinéma. Soyons honnêtes un instant. Arrêtons de faire croire qu’il reste quoi que ce soit à Cancel de lui !

citations.translated_citation: So let us stop pretending that we suffer from selective blindness. No one is asking to “cancel” Depardieu. '''This is an attempt to portray a sexual aggressor as a victim even though he has repeatedly and publicly owned his behavior.''' Depardieu is celebrating his seventy-fifth birthday. He can barely walk. He has had a long film career. Let us be honest for a moment. Let us stop pretending that there is anything left of him to cancel!
